definitions.gloss: the hard outer shell of an egg
definitions.explanation: The hard, brittle outer covering of a bird's egg, mostly made of calcium carbonate. A somewhat technical or written term.

examples.japanese: {卵殻|らんかく}は{炭酸|たんさん}カルシウムでできている。
examples.english: Eggshells are made of calcium carbonate.

examples.japanese: {卵殻|らんかく}を{細|こま}かく{砕|くだ}いた。
examples.english: I crushed the eggshell into small pieces.

examples.japanese: {卵殻|らんかく}を{肥料|ひりょう}として{畑|はたけ}にまく{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: Some people scatter eggshells on fields as fertilizer.

notes:
A technical or written term for an eggshell. In everyday conversation, {卵|たまご}の{殻|から} is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卵殻|らんかく}を{砕|くだ}く: to crush an eggshell
- {卵殻|らんかく}{膜|まく}: eggshell membrane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {殻|から}: shell — the general word for a shell of an egg, nut, or shellfish
- {卵|たまご}の{殻|から}: eggshell — the everyday phrasing of the same thing
